_about: app-input (App & Input): wording, conditions, units and bounds from the plain-pages audit (2026-09-27). Hand rows (accent, animation-speed, sidebar-labels, startup-view, spellcheck, dictionaries, custom-words) are worded here too.

general.visual.theme.label: Theme
general.visual.theme.help: Pick a look; each one has a dark and a light version.

general.visual.theme-mode.label: Light or dark
general.visual.theme-mode.help: Switches the chosen theme between its light and dark versions.

general.visual.accent-color.label: Accent color
general.visual.accent-color.help: The color of selections, focus outlines and progress; the first keeps the theme's own.

general.visual.basic-color-scheme.label: Light or dark for Basic (older setting)
general.visual.basic-color-scheme.help: Kept for older projects; Light or dark above now decides.

general.visual.theme-preview.label: Preview a theme before switching
general.visual.theme-preview.help: Try a look while browsing; it snaps back unless you apply it.

general.visual.glass-background-mode.label: Glass background
general.visual.glass-background-mode.help: What shows behind the see-through panels.

general.visual.glass-transparency.label: How see-through panels are
general.visual.glass-transparency.help: Text always stays readable, whatever you choose.

general.visual.retro-effects.label: Retro textures
general.visual.retro-effects.help: Pixel grid, paper and scanline overlays on Retro themes.

general.visual.app-font.label: App font
general.visual.app-font.help: Retro themes use display fonts; pick your computer's to use its everyday fonts.

general.visual.ui-scale.label: Size of everything
general.visual.ui-scale.help: Makes the whole app bigger or smaller.

general.visual.font-size.label: Text size
general.visual.font-size.help: Base size of text in the app; code has its own size.

general.visual.interface-density.label: Spacing
general.visual.interface-density.help: Automatic adapts to the size of your window.

general.visual.reduce-animations.label: Reduce motion
general.visual.reduce-animations.help: Stops decorative movement; everything still works the same.

general.visual.animation-speed.label: Animation speed
general.visual.animation-speed.help: How quickly panels and pages move.

general.visual.high-contrast.label: High contrast
general.visual.high-contrast.help: Stronger colors and edges, for the Basic theme.

general.visual.focus-indicator.label: Keyboard focus outline
general.visual.focus-indicator.help: How the outline around the focused control looks.

general.visual.chat-layout-mode.label: Where the chat sits
general.visual.chat-layout-mode.help: Only the chat; other panels have their own choice.

flow.empty: No themes of your own yet. The eight built-in looks are under Appearance.

items.label: Tastebook Night
items.help: Based on Glass Dark · made by you

items.label: High contrast warm
items.help: Imported from a file · 1 problem skipped

general.visual.manage-custom-themes.label: Your own themes
general.visual.manage-custom-themes.help: Create, import or export your own theme files.

general.visual.custom-theme-base.label: Start custom themes from
general.visual.custom-theme-base.help: Colors you leave out come from this theme.

general.visual.padding-scale.label: Extra padding
general.visual.padding-scale.help: Fine-tunes space inside panels, on top of Spacing.

general.visual.border-width.label: Border width
general.visual.border-width.help: Thickness of panel and control borders.

general.interaction.submit-key.label: Key that sends a message
general.interaction.submit-key.help: Ctrl+Enter avoids sending a half-typed message.

general.interaction.queue-behavior.label: If I send while it is busy
general.interaction.queue-behavior.help: Wait holds your message until the current step is done; Steer sends it into the running reply at once.

general.interaction.queue-size.label: Messages that can wait
general.interaction.queue-size.help: When the line is full, new messages must wait.

general.interaction.edit-resend.label: Edit and resend my last message

general.interaction.composer-persist-uns.label: Keep what I was typing
general.interaction.composer-persist-uns.help: Unsent text stays in each chat when you switch or close.

general.interaction.assistant-mode.label: New chats start in
general.interaction.assistant-mode.help: Ask only answers, Agent makes changes, Plan thinks first. What Agent may do is set in Permissions.

general.interaction.natural-language-mod.label: Change modes by asking
general.interaction.natural-language-mod.help: Say "use plan mode" to switch in the middle of a chat.

general.interaction.question-cards.label: Ask me questions as cards
general.interaction.question-cards.help: Choices and a text box instead of a wall of text.

general.interaction.question-drafts.label: Keep half-written answers
general.interaction.question-drafts.help: Closing a question card never loses what you typed.

planning.interview.todo-auto-use.label: Keep a checklist for big tasks
planning.interview.todo-auto-use.help: Multi-step work gets its own checklist so no step is missed.

general.interaction.activity-cards.label: Show what the assistant does
general.interaction.activity-cards.help: Cards for commands, web searches and file edits.

general.interaction.file-discovery-cards.label: Show when it reads files
general.interaction.file-discovery-cards.help: Safety and approval messages always show.

general.interaction.mermaid.label: Draw diagrams
general.interaction.mermaid.help: Diagram code in chat shows as a picture.

general.interaction.inline-visualizers.label: Interactive charts and previews
general.interaction.inline-visualizers.help: Small sandboxed widgets that can't touch your files.

general.interaction.mode.label: How the app talks to me
general.interaction.mode.help: Plain English hides jargon and rarely used controls.

general.interaction.eli5-default.label: Explain technical terms in chats
general.interaction.eli5-default.help: On for every new chat; a chat's own switch wins.

general.interaction.chat-eli5.label: Explain terms in the chat I have open
general.interaction.chat-eli5.help: Only that chat; its menu has the same switch.

general.interaction.scope-labels.label: Show where each setting comes from

general.interaction.rediscoverability.label: Keep hidden features findable
general.interaction.rediscoverability.help: Hidden features still appear in search and commands.

general.interaction.minimize-to-tray.label: Keep running when I close the window
general.interaction.minimize-to-tray.help: It hides in the system tray so work keeps going.

general.interaction.dashboard-widgets.label: Dashboard widgets
general.interaction.dashboard-widgets.help: Opens the dashboard's widget picker on Home.

general.interaction.panel-dock.label: Other side panels
general.interaction.panel-dock.help: Files, source control and the rest, but not the chat.

general.interaction.activity-bar-order.label: Order of the icons on the left

general.interaction.activity-bar-labels.label: Show names next to those icons

general.startup.first-screen.label: First screen when Puppet Master opens
general.startup.first-screen.help: The page you land on; the side panel is chosen below.

general.startup.restore-panel.label: Side panel when a project opens

general.startup.window-state.label: Remember window size and layout
general.startup.window-state.help: Size, position, panel widths and splits come back as you left them.

general.startup.crash-restore.label: Bring my work back after a crash

general.startup.unsaved-capture.label: Protect unsaved changes
general.startup.unsaved-capture.help: Keeps copies of unsaved edits so a crash can't lose them.

general.interaction.spellcheck.label: Check spelling
general.interaction.spellcheck.help: In chat and notes; code is never marked.

general.interaction.spellcheck-words.label: Words to always accept
general.interaction.spellcheck-words.help: Names and terms the spell checker should not flag.

general.interaction.settings-search.label: Search all settings
general.interaction.settings-search.help: Takes you to the search box at the top of Settings.

general.startup.reset-home-layout.message: Home panels, docks, the terminal position and floating windows go back to the default. Open files, terminal sessions, the browser, dashboard widgets and chats are kept.
general.startup.reset-home-layout.label: Reset the layout
general.startup.reset-home-layout.help: Puts panels back; open files, terminals and chats stay.

general.visual.nier-mode.label: NieR Mode
general.visual.nier-mode.help: Paints the whole app in NieR: Automata's ink and parchment, in light or dark. Your theme comes back when you turn it off.

general.visual.nier-parts.label: Customize NieR Mode
general.visual.nier-parts.help: Choose which pieces of the look, motion, sound and world are installed.

general.visual.nier-background.label: NieR background
general.visual.nier-background.help: A faint ink scene behind the app, or plain parchment.
